title: Water of Purification

questions.question: What animal was required for the water of purification ordinance?
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:2 (ESV): "Bring you a red heifer without defect..."

questions.question: Where was the heifer to be slaughtered?
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:3 (ESV): "And you shall give it to Eleazar... and it shall be taken outside the camp and slaughtered..."

questions.question: What was thrown into the fire with the heifer?
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:6 (ESV): "And the priest shall take cedarwood and hyssop and scarlet yarn, and throw them into the fire..."

questions.question: What were the ashes used for?
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:9 (ESV): "Kept for the water for impurity."

questions.question: Touching a dead body made one unclean for how long?
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:11 (ESV): "Whoever touches the dead body... shall be unclean seven days."

questions.question: On which days must the unclean person cleanse himself?
options: The third day and the seventh day
questions.correctAnswer: The third day and the seventh day
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:12 (ESV): "He shall cleanse himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day..."

questions.question: What happens to the open vessel in a tent with a dead body?
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:15 (ESV): "And every open vessel that has no cover fastened on it is unclean."

questions.question: Who gathered the ashes of the heifer?
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:9 (ESV): "And a man who is clean shall gather up the ashes..."

questions.question: If one fails to cleanse himself, what is the consequence?
options: He defiles the tabernacle of the Lord and shall be cut off
questions.correctAnswer: He defiles the tabernacle of the Lord and shall be cut off
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:13 (ESV): "Defiles the tabernacle of the Lord, and that person shall be cut off..."

questions.question: Does the one who sprinkles the water become unclean?
options: Yes, he shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, he shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:21 (ESV): "He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes... unclean until evening."

questions.question: Is this statute for the stranger as well?
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:10 (ESV): "It shall be for the people of Israel and for the stranger... a statute forever."

questions.question: What makes the red heifer unique in sacrifices?
options: Slaughtered outside the camp and wholly burnt to ash
questions.correctAnswer: Slaughtered outside the camp and wholly burnt to ash
questions.explanation: Most sacrifices are at the altar; this one is wholly outside to produce ash for water.

questions.question: What plant is used in the sprinkling device?
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:18 (ESV): "Then a clean person shall take hyssop and dip it in the water..."

questions.question: Who applies the blood to the tent of meeting?
options: Eleazar sprinkles it toward the front
questions.correctAnswer: Eleazar sprinkles it toward the front
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:4 (ESV): "And Eleazar the priest... sprinkle some of its blood toward the front of the tent of meeting seven times."

questions.question: Touching a grave makes one unclean for how long?
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:16 (ESV): "Whoever in the open field touches... a grave, shall be unclean seven days."

key_verse_text: Tell the people of Israel to bring you a red heifer without defect, in which there is no blemish, and on which a yoke has never come.
